reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically sound and aligns with well-established tribocorrosion mechanisms, though it lacks specific quantitative details on the differential oxide behavior of fcc and B2 phases.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and uses appropriate techniques, but the falsification criterion is somewhat circular (measuring oxide removal to prove oxide removal) and lacks a decisive, independent metric.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is useful as a foundational starting point, but it is a well-known general mechanism and does not offer a novel, alloy-specific insight that would strongly advance research on this specific material system.
